recipientAddress.description: YOUR Solana wallet address (base58) — where payments settle. Public key only; the skill never holds custody. Required.

priceUsdc.description: Default price per request in USDC. Default: 0.01.

network.description: Settlement network. Default: solana-mainnet. Set solana-devnet to test.

requireOnChain.description: Accept a payment only after its transaction is confirmed settled on Solana (revenue-grade). Default: true. Setting false runs only the structural/presenter checks and does NOT verify the payment settled on-chain — a caller can pass the gate without actually paying (the tx signature is caller-supplied and never checked against the chain). Testing only; never set false for real paid content on mainnet.

dedupe.description: Reject a settled payment that has already been redeemed (single-use). Default: true. In-memory unless replayStorePath is set.

replayStorePath.description: File path for a restart-durable single-instance replay store. REQUIRED on mainnet when dedupe=true — the gate refuses to run with in-memory dedupe on mainnet (replay reopens on restart). For multi-instance, back replay with your own durable store and set dedupe=false.

requirePresenterAuth.description: Require the caller to sign the gate-issued nonce with the payer key, so an observer of the on-chain payment can't replay it for free access. Default: true, and FORCED ON for solana-mainnet (cannot be disabled). Needs an x402 client that signs the challenge nonce.

challengeSecret.description: Secret used to MAC presenter-auth nonces and capability tokens. REQUIRED on mainnet (presenter-auth nonces must verify across restarts/instances). Omit only on devnet for an ephemeral per-process secret.

receiptScopeSeconds.description: If > 0, a verified payment returns a capability token the payer can re-present to reuse this resource WITHOUT paying again, until it expires (seconds). 'Pay once, reuse within scope' — a subscription/credit model. Default: 0 (off; pay per call). On mainnet requires replayStorePath.

acknowledgeSingleInstance.description: Attest you run a SINGLE gate instance. Required on mainnet with dedupe=true + replayStorePath, because the file-backed replay store is single-instance only (multiple replicas would each redeem a payment once). Default: false.

acknowledgeExternalReplayStore.description: Attest you enforce replay protection with your own durable, SHARED store (Redis/DB). Required on mainnet when dedupe=false. Default: false.

rpcUrl.description: Solana RPC URL for on-chain confirmation. A private/dedicated node is strongly recommended on mainnet (the RPC is fully trusted for the settlement decision).
